name: Suzhou Huazhijie Telecom Co
summary: Suzhou Huazhijie Telecommunications Co., Ltd., a national high-tech enterprise established in 1992, is headquartered in Suzhou, China. The company specializes in the research, development, and production of a diverse range of advanced components, including smart switches, control modules, battery management systems (BMS), brushless motors and their controllers, and precision mechanical parts. Operating as a worldwide supplier, it serves critical sectors such as power tools, consumer electronics, and the automotive industry, notably providing comprehensive, ready-to-use solutions specifically for power tool applications.
